_README: Template for the Citrate Memories team allowlist. The LIVE file lives on the gateway host at $MEM_TEAM_ALLOWLIST (production: /var/lib/memrizz/team-allowlist.json), holds real team PII, and is NOT committed to git. Copy this schema, fill it in there, and the gateway auto-provisions each listed person on their first auth.citrate.ai login. See docs/TEAM_ACCESS.md.
